name: C.I.N.N. (Contact Improvisation Nippon Network)
underground_reason: Non-profit group of Kanto dancers that runs the Tokyo Contact Improvisation Festival and lists community CI workshops and jams
notes: Founded as SPIRAL in 2003. The 2026 festival was held in Katsuura, Chiba. Possibly related to tyo-nishiogi-ci, which cites the same website, but I did not confirm the link; the main session should check before merging.

name: Body Arts Laboratory (Whenever Wherever Festival)
underground_reason: Artist-run dance and performance organisation; its festival uses public and community spaces rather than theatres
last_active_evidence: WWFes 2026 (12th edition) held February 2026 in Minato Ward
notes: Founded 2008; became a general incorporated association in 2021 (per Arts Council Tokyo).
